source: notebooks/marine_pollution_prediction.ipynb on branch environmental-risk-module (AnannyaJadhav, commit ce03377, run 2026-10-14). Values copied from the notebook's printed outputs.
region: Gulf of Mannar / Palk Bay (Allen Coral Atlas polygon)

data_sources.ocean: Copernicus Marine global analysis: currents (uo, vo), sea temperature (thetao), wave height (VHM0)
data_sources.biodiversity: OBIS occurrence records since 2000: 6,208 raw, 5,254 after cleaning, 3,536 species

target: log1p(species_richness) within 10 km of each site
limitations: No plastic data in the score yet (plastic_risk is 0 for every site).
IUCN Red List field is empty in the OBIS download, so sensitive_species is 0 everywhere.
115 of 245 sites have no OBIS records within 10 km, so richness partly reflects survey effort.
Habitat sensitivity weights (coral 1.0, seagrass 0.8, rubble 0.4, rock 0.3, sand 0.1) are assumptions.
Random K-fold CV on neighbouring grid cells is optimistic; held-out test R2 is 0.157.
